note: Only figures read off the maker's own datasheet. Each Dk says what it is: 'process' (the maker's QC test value), 'design' (the maker's recommendation for circuit design), or 'typical' (a typical value at the stated frequency, with no separate design value published). Impedance sizing takes the design value when there is one, else the typical value nearest the frequency asked for. conventions holds values that are not datasheet figures at all, and fab_figures holds a fab's number for its own stack, which has no measurement conditions and does not carry over to another fab.

conventions.name: FR-4 (generic)
conventions.note: NOT a material specification. 'FR-4' names a flammability rating, not a formulation, and its permittivity varies with the glass style, the resin content and the frequency. Carried as a RANGE so it cannot be mistaken for a datasheet figure. Use the laminate your fab actually presses, or the er in that fab's own stackup template.
